Stock Exchange road,
Karachi.
Subject:
Disclosure of Material Information
Dear Sir,
In accordance with the requirements of the Rule Book of Pakistan Stock Exchange Limited and
applicable provisions of the Securities Act, 2015, we hereby convey the following information:
"This is to inform that, D.G. Khan Cement Company Ltd., has signed an agreement with EBR
Energy Pakistan (Pvt.) Limited, Sungrow Power Supply Co. Ltd., China and Pragmatic
Engineering Solutions FZE., for the Supply & Erection of 25MW PV Solar Power Plant and
10MWH BESS (Battery Energy Storage System) in our Cement Plant located at Mauza Khofli
Sattai, Dera Ghazi Khan. The project is expected to start power generation in the month of
March 2027.""
A disclosure form is attached herewith (Annexure “A").
You may please inform the members of your Exchange, accordingly.
Yours' sincerey,
Khalid Mahmood Chohan
CompanySecretary
